verdict_scope: No actionable content blocker in the complete seven-file planning diff. This is LOCAL evidence only: not native approval, review-round credit, implementation admission, merge authorization, board validation, or gameplay acceptance.

scope.evidence_scope: Read the complete union proof, every added receipt/reflection/event and surrounding diff context; inspected and independently verified byte preservation without interpreting Rheos semantics. Complete historical ledgers were not reread as narrative.

assessments.reason: The actual GLFW press callback calls request-op through IntentAtom; queued actions drain before sim-loop prepares manual focus. Real cadence tests expose published pre-fold attention versus moved/recentered physical positions. The older pilot seam explicitly calls focus-follow before request-op, so it does not prove ordinary queued timing. The note correctly treats the new gap as source-derived and the amendment as proposed.

A named validated contextual entry is a bounded extension of the existing queue, guarded application and single simulation owner. Explicit dev-window opt-in prevents absent-capability plain Atom clients from acquiring manual-mode semantics. Legacy IFn, including map/keyword callables, reset and result guards remain specified. The plan rejects hidden config rereads, callable identity dispatch, blanket per-intent preparation and a second action path.

One mode/offset projection C_n per iteration and each serial W_j define the consumer state, including mid-drain arrivals. Host changes after snapshot defer; prior world changes remain FIFO. Persistent preparation intentionally changes later-reader attention even on valid-aim denied payment. Existing request-op remains responsible for target/palette/funds and immutable paid records; final preparation and Jacobi fold timing remain unchanged.

The manual-only no-observer shortcut is explicit. With an observer present, offset/position failures precede domain gates and preserve W_j within the same Throwable guard. Successful preparation with denied gates returns P_j without payment. Tracking calls unchanged request-op, retaining verb/magnitude validation before the observer gate. Absent keys versus explicit nil, visible stderr errors, malformed capability/context, recovery and no fallback are specified.

The RED matrix requires actual opted-in callback, IntentAtom and sim-loop after a real integrator fold, non-collinear motion and common translations, snapshot races/mid-drain arrivals, interleaving/payment/reader outcomes, invalid-input combinations, compatibility, press/repeat/release, and real sculpt fan-out. Existing tests are correctly distinguished from future RED and natural gameplay acceptance.

Three points is reasonable for this design continuation and plausibly for one bounded adapter/composition repair with existing domain functions. Exact named representation/validators and final implementation sizing remain explicit admission prerequisites; a broader queue/API change triggers breakdown into payload compatibility and action ordering. Current base contains the necessary callback/queue/focus/sculpt infrastructure; no new hard feature dependency is concealed. G/H/J placement, pursuit, HUD lag, new controls/costs, creation/embodiment and Gate production are explicitly outside this amendment. Existing card gameplay acceptance stays open.

All changed worktree files equal exact-head blobs, relevant source/tests equal the note pinned revision, and production/test/config paths have no PR delta. The union proof reproduces exact common prefix plus both complete appends; the receipt file has only the later 916-byte composition receipt after the proved union. Earlier comments are explicitly superseded rather than silently rewritten.
